prompt: Explain how AI models are used by material, scientists, and elaborate upon the benefits that they provide to those scientists.
judge_reasoning: Candidate 1 most directly matches the prompt by explaining how AI models are used in materials science and explicitly connecting these uses to concrete benefits for scientists (e.g., faster discovery, reduced cost, better simulations/optimization). Candidate 4 is also relevant and covers many of the same application areas, but it is more method/overview oriented and less consistently focused on benefits. Candidate 2 largely shifts to challenges and omits much of the requested “benefits” emphasis, while Candidate 3 reframes the task into a materials-vs-pharma comparison, missing the prompt’s target focus for benefits in materials science.
